text: Per the Dutch AFM register of substantial holdings, UBS Group AG notified on 18 September 2026 a total capital interest of 7.27% (and 7.27% of voting rights) in DSM-Firmenich AG, held indirectly through UBS asset-management and bank entities.

source.name: AFM register of substantial holdings and gross short positions: UBS Group AG – DSM-Firmenich AG
source.quote: Person obliged to notify UBS Group AG Issuing institution DSM-Firmenich AG
